meta.name: pptx
meta.description: Use this skill any time a .pptx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email or summary); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates, layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user mentions "deck," "slides," "presentation," or references a .pptx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. If a .pptx file needs to be opened, created, or touched, use this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建、编辑或提取演示文稿内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要处理任何 .pptx 格式的演示文稿文件
copy.tagline_en: Create, edit, or extract content from presentations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to work with any .pptx presentation file

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能创建、读取、编辑 .pptx 文件，包括提取文字、生成缩略图、修改幻灯片、合并拆分文件，以及从模板或空白创建演示文稿。
howto.when: 当你提到“幻灯片”、“演示文稿”、“deck”或 .pptx 文件名时触发。也适用于任何需要打开、创建或处理 .pptx 文件的场景。

say.text: 帮我从这份 .pptx 里提取所有文字。
say.note: Claude 会运行 markitdown 提取文本。

say.text: 用这个模板创建一份 5 页的演示文稿。
say.note: Claude 会读取模板并生成新幻灯片。

say.text: 把这两份 .pptx 合并成一个文件。
say.note: Claude 会合并幻灯片文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create, read, and edit .pptx files, including extracting text, generating thumbnails, modifying slides, merging/splitting files, and creating presentations from templates or scratch.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "slides," "presentation," "deck," or a .pptx filename. Also applies whenever a .pptx file needs to be opened, created, or processed.

say_en.text: Extract all text from this .pptx file.
say_en.note: Claude will run markitdown to extract text.

say_en.text: Create a 5-slide presentation using this template.
say_en.note: Claude will read the template and generate new slides.

say_en.text: Merge these two .pptx files into one.
say_en.note: Claude will combine the slide files.
